summary: New shared DeadCount(playerId) helper on MatchEngine -- the single source of truth for a player's own count of Zone.Dead Personalities -- and a new PlayerView.DeadCount field exposing that same authoritative aggregate to the client (the same convention CardView.UnitForce already established), for a future UI counter and any card keyed off 'count of dead' (a real, recurring Unicorn Clan theme; Moto Shunsuke's own already-published force-max-dead-pile Effect is the first consumer, refactored to read through the shared helper instead of its own inline filter).
